rule: docs/TREE_PLAN.md: one yard tree for every two or three houses, in back yards and at lot corners, never against a fence or a wall (zone 813 -> about 400)
written: by hand, 19 Nov 2026 (cloud session, the city-wide superchecker run from the bottom of the list). The quadrant's seventeen builder trees go (corals, magnolias, ficus and jacarandas along the back fences, jacarandas and a magnolia 3 m from the house fronts, a few in the yards inside the wrought-iron fence); five come back on their own spots, about one for every two houses: by the arbor and the grill, on the open lot corner, in two yards inside the iron fence, and one back yard.

trees.why: the back yard with the garden arbor and the gas grill: a magnolia beside them
the open lot corner inside the wrought-iron fence, 25 m from the walls: a full magnolia
the yard north of it, 10 m from the house, 31 m from the magnolia
the middle yard inside the same fence by the bird of paradise, 12.5 m from the house
